Issue #420:
Loguru is not api compatible with standard logging despite efforts in #294, so it may be best to raise an error or wrap the loguru logger with a standard logger when doing this

```python
from loguru import logger
@retry(
    stop=stop_after_attempt(10),
    wait=wait_random_exponential(multiplier=1, max=10),
    reraise=True,
    before_sleep=before_sleep_log(logger, "ERROR"),  # type: ignore
    after=after_log(logger, "ERROR"),  # type: ignore
)
```

As it can cause a `KeyError` due to [this](https://github.com/Delgan/loguru/issues/1008#issuecomment-1773199101) 

[Here's](https://github.com/Delgan/loguru/issues/1008#issuecomment-1773257442) a wrapping approach which may be the best thing for people to setup in accordance with their own logging needs. Not sure if @Delgan has a better approach though.

Pull request title:
fix: format traceback inline for loguru compatibility

Pull request body:
Stop passing `exc_info=` as a kwarg to `logger.log()`. Standard
`logging.Logger` treats this specially (appends traceback), but loguru
interprets all kwargs as message format parameters, causing a KeyError.

Instead, format the traceback into the message string directly using
`traceback.format_exception()`. This works with all loggers that
implement `LoggerProtocol` (logging, loguru, structlog, etc.).

Also tighten `LoggerProtocol.log()` by removing `**kwargs` since we
no longer pass any keyword arguments.

Fixes #420

import logging
import unittest.mock

from tenacity import before_sleep_log, RetryCallState


def _make_failed_retry_state() -> RetryCallState:
    """Create a RetryCallState that simulates a failed attempt."""
    retry_state = RetryCallState(None, None, (), {})
    retry_state.attempt_number = 1
    try:
        raise RuntimeError("test error")
    except RuntimeError:
        retry_state.set_exception()
    retry_state.upcoming_sleep = 0.5
    retry_state.start_time = 0
    retry_state.outcome_timestamp = 0.1
    return retry_state


class TestBeforeSleepLogLoguruCompat(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test that before_sleep_log works with loguru-style loggers."""

    def test_before_sleep_log_with_exc_info_loguru_compat(self) -> None:
        """before_sleep_log(exc_info=True) should not pass exc_info kwarg to logger.log()."""
        # A logger that rejects exc_info kwarg, like loguru does
        def log_reject_exc_info(level, msg, *args, **kwargs):
            if "exc_info" in kwargs:
                raise KeyError("exc_info is not a valid format key")
            return None

        logger = unittest.mock.MagicMock(spec=["log"])
        logger.log.side_effect = log_reject_exc_info

        before_sleep = before_sleep_log(logger, logging.INFO, exc_info=True)
        retry_state = _make_failed_retry_state()

        before_sleep(retry_state)

        assert call_kwargs is not None

        assert "exc_info" not in kwargs, (
